items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: It's like, this says, do you know that Miles Davis now has to tell people who I am?

ctx.x: Yeah. But don't you think that's

The whole scene is changing, because the youth today doesn't want to know nothing about it. They want to pick up a kazoo, don't tell me nothing about it, how you play the kazoo, or a banjo, anything. The new age -- they're not into it.

In fact, Feather now is getting put down. I read something where somebody called him moldy. Because naturally, how can you keep on going? There's somebody that you came in on the scene with, and that to you identifies you. Those are your people. Meanwhile, the world moves on. Twenty years later new people come on the scene and they've got nothing to do with you. It's like, this says, do you know that Miles Davis now has to tell people who I am?
